cases.scenario: Valid patient record with complete clinical history and clear MRI findings
cases.expected: Generates a complete report consistent with the supplied information
cases.evidence: all five stages succeeded and a report was produced

cases.scenario: Patient record with relevant medical history and straightforward evidence retrieval
cases.expected: Incorporates relevant history and retrieves appropriate supporting evidence

cases.scenario: Patient record contains missing clinical information
cases.expected: Identifies missing details without inventing information
cases.evidence: report produced: True; mentions missing information: ['unknown', 'not provided']

cases.scenario: MRI findings require multiple relevant medical evidence sources
cases.expected: Produces a report supported by relevant evidence and valid citations
cases.evidence: report produced: True; 4 retrieved sources cited in the report

cases.scenario: CDS output contains an unsupported clinical claim
cases.expected: Identifies, removes or flags the unsupported claim before finalising the report
cases.evidence: bad claim absent from final report: True; verification flagged it (revision rounds: 1, report produced: True)

cases.scenario: Retrieved evidence contains a citation that does not support its associated claim
cases.expected: Detects the citation mismatch and avoids presenting the claim as verified
cases.evidence: bad claim absent from final report: True; verification flagged it (revision rounds: 1, report produced: True)

cases.scenario: Clinical history and supplied findings contain conflicting information
cases.expected: Identifies the inconsistency and communicates uncertainty appropriately
cases.evidence: conflict mentioned in the report, uncertainties or errors: False

cases.scenario: Evidence retrieval tool returns no results or encounters an error
cases.expected: Handles the failure gracefully and does not fabricate supporting evidence
cases.evidence: evidence stage: failed; report produced: False; evidence items: 0

cases.scenario: Invalid or nonexistent patient ID is supplied
cases.expected: Reports the patient record cannot be found and avoids a misleading patient-specific report
cases.evidence: patient stage: failed; report produced: False; said not found: True

cases.scenario: Previously unseen patient case with a combination of findings not used during development
cases.expected: Processes the case accurately, generates an appropriate report and handles evidence limitations
cases.evidence: report produced: True; uncertainties stated: True
